topic: Adding new facility data to KIDO
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the urgent need to populate KIDO with new facility data, specifically requiring integration with social classes. One participant noted that a previous process involved selecting facilities based on proximity and copying demographic data from existing records.

A temporary solution was implemented by another participant who created a view (`v_ch_facility_without_kido`) joining facilities lacking KIDO data with the nearest facility data provided by a third party. This method was described as quick but potentially inaccurate, involving a direct 1:1 copy of data to ensure some information was available.
decisions: The immediate need is to populate KIDO with new facility data including social classes.
